sidebar.title: Account Settings
sidebar.desc: Manage your profile, notifications, orders, and transaction history.

email_reminders.title: Health reminder email
email_reminders.desc: Choose whether to receive a morning greeting and a reminder to update your Health Goals.
email_reminders.morning_title: Start the day with your Health Goals
email_reminders.morning_desc: The system plans one email between 07:00 and 08:59 Vietnam time and skips it after you have submitted today's health update.
email_reminders.recipient_note: The email is sent to this account's sign-in address.
email_reminders.eligibility_note: Email is only sent while you have an active coaching package and an assigned trainer. You can turn it off at any time.

profile.title: Personal Information
profile.desc: Basic information about your account and address.

orders.title: My Orders
orders.desc: List of packages and services you registered or purchased.
orders.search_placeholder: Search by order ID or package name...
orders.no_orders: You do not have any orders yet.
orders.fitness_plus_cycle_desc: Cycle: {{cycle}} | Track your journey with digital tools

history.title: Payment History
history.desc: Track your balance adjustments and deposit history.

contracts.title: My Contracts
contracts.desc: View and sign personal coaching contracts.
contracts.name: Contract Name
contracts.no_contracts: You don't have any contracts yet.
contracts.download_already: You have already downloaded this contract. Each contract can only be downloaded once.
contracts.download_success: Contract downloaded successfully! Note: You can only download it once.

my_history.title: MY HISTORY
my_history.desc: Track your workouts, check-ins, and results

wallet.title: My Wallet
wallet.needs_review_desc: The system is reconciling the transaction. An admin will review mismatched codes or amounts.
wallet.pending_desc: Please complete or wait for the current transaction to expire before making a new request.
wallet.warning_alert: Please transfer the EXACT amount and enter the EXACT description for automatic validation.
wallet.automatic_note: Once the bank records your transfer, the wallet is credited automatically when both the amount and deposit code match.
wallet.late_payment_note: The QR has expired, but a matching transfer made within 24 hours after expiry is still reconciled.
wallet.confirmed_desc: The wallet is credited automatically when the bank transaction matches the amount and deposit code.
wallet.confirmed_help: An admin will review the actual incoming transaction when the transfer details do not match.
wallet.qr_desc: The QR code is valid for 15 minutes. Please transfer the exact amount and description.
